name: Resources Demo (art, help, prefs)
author: neostryder
description: A framework proof, not a mod anyone plays: it keeps the resource seam (MOD_REACH gap 7) exercised. Three of the five categories a mod can supply without being compiled into the app - the title screen's art, a help page and a pref file - each in its own file, declared in `resources`, and each read by the part of the game that owns it. The other two need bytes too big to keep in the tree for a dev-only demo: a complete font is tens of kilobytes and a sound pack is audio. Both are proven from real files on disk by mod-resources.node.test.ts instead. Dev builds only.
